items.name: Change Race
items.overview: Change Race is a Product that allows a player to switch their race to either Human, Shark, Rabbit, or Angel. The player cannot obtain the race they are currently using. If the player’s current race is Human, Shark, Rabbit, or Angel, there is a 1/3 chance of obtaining each of the other available races. However, if the player’s current race is Draco, Ghoul, or Cyborg, the chance becomes 1/4 for each of the four available races, since none of them are excluded. Ghoul, Draco, and Cyborg cannot be obtained through this product.

items.name: Dragon Token
items.overview: The Dragon Token was added after Update 24, when the Dragon Fruit was reworked. It was introduced as a form of compensation for players who previously owned physical versions of the Dragon Fruit that were affected by the rework. After the update, old physical Dragon Fruits (both stored and equipped) were automatically exchanged into Dragon Tokens, which could be found in the player's inventory.

The Basic Raid Microchip can be used to start Basic Raids by pressing a button in a Raid area. Players standing inside of the light blue tubes in the Hot and Cold island (Second Sea) or on top of the yellow platforms in Castle on the Sea (Third Sea) will be teleported to the Raid event.*To purchase a Basic Raid Microchip, the player needs to be Lvl. 1100 or higher.

items.overview: The Permanent Dragon Token was added after Update 24, where the Dragon Fruit was reworked. Just like the Dragon Token, the Permanent Dragon Token was created to compensate previous owners affected by the Dragon rework. Previous owners of the Dragon Fruit in its permanent form were automatically compensated, as their old permanent Dragon was exchanged into a Permanent Dragon Token, which could be found in the player's inventory after the update.

items.overview: Stats Refund, or Stat Reset, are an obtainable option to reset all stats and return the stat points, for the player to re-select their stats.

items.name: Summer Token
items.overview: The Summer Token could be obtained through several methods: collecting Summer Chests, participating in Fish Fights, ranked 2v2 matches, joining hourly events where players must defend the Spirit Tree in either the Oni Realm or Celestial Domain. Additionally, every five minutes, a smaller raid event occurs, featuring either the Agony boss (which later becomes tormented) or Ashen boss that summons a group of Lightning Bandits.

items.name: Trident
items.overview: It allows the user to use water based moves, and is a useful sword for mobility on land and late First Sea to early Second Sea grinding. However, it is outclassed by many Second Sea swords, which are generally considered better for all activities.

items.name: Twin Hooks
